name: @webhooksite/cli
description: A console utility used to interact with the Webhook.site API and proxy/forward/tunnel requests from a Webhook.site URL to any destination on your local network.

scripts.build: export VERSION=$(jq -r '.version' package.json) ; sed -i '' "s/const version = '[0-9.]*';/const version = '$VERSION';/" index.js ; npm install ; git tag $VERSION ; git push origin refs/tags/$VERSION ; docker buildx build --platform linux/arm/v7,linux/arm64/v8,linux/amd64,linux/arm64 --tag webhooksite/cli:latest --tag webhooksite/cli:$VERSION --push . ; npm publish
